Inspired by craft. Grounded in purpose.
Showcase research translated into GGCF’s own identity — reference concepts, not copied page designs.
HopeRise / Phenomenon
DRIBBBLE / CONCEPT
Borrow: generous whitespace, oversized type, warm neutral surfaces, and a confident donation path.

Borrow: concise navigation, restrained hierarchy, and a distinctive identity that feels optimistic.

BEHANCE / BRAND CASE STUDY
Luminar Foundation

Borrow: strategy-led identity and a coherent relationship between type, color, and storytelling.
DRIBBBLE / CONCEPT
Voices United
Phenomenon / 2025
Borrow: an editorial story hub and modular ways to participate.
behance.net/gallery/252149809 dribbble.com/shots/26183245
01 / SPACE & GRID
8 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64 · 96
Desktop: 12 columns, max 1280px, 24px gutters. Tablet: 8 columns / 32px margins. Mobile: 4 columns / 20px margins.
Controls: 8px radius / 52px height. Cards: 16px radius. Arch crops belong to feature photography.
02 / ACCESS & MOTION
Clear in every state.
Visible focus; 44px minimum targets; persistent labels; errors with recovery instructions. Never rely on color alone.
150–220ms transitions. Respect reduced motion. Avoid autoplay carousels and decorative delays.
03 / CONTENT & FLOW
Mission → work → proof → give
Real GGCF photographs, meaningful captions, dignified crops, and consent. Preserve the faith-centered mission.
Verify statistics and reporting periods. Monthly giving requires a real recurring payment integration; current giving continues to PayPal.

Who We Are
Good God Charity Foundation
Good God Charity Foundation is a Non-profit Charitable Foundation founded in 2022 with a dedication to improving child health and education in Ghana and beyond. Through healthcare programs, educational support, and community outreach, we aim to raise awareness, increase donations, and foster community involvement in underrepresented areas. Join us in making a difference today.
Learn More →
Join Us →
MOTION / WORKING PROTOTYPE
Hero: 700ms entrance / 20px travel
Sections: 650ms reveal / 22px travel. Photos: desktop parallax, maximum 34px. Cards: pointer-driven perspective, ±1.5°. Controls: 200ms feedback.
Mobile: natural scrolling, no parallax or tilt. Reduced motion: immediate content, static photos and cards. Carousel: manual navigation, both original slides retained.
